title: Make every jump part of the map.
description: Build a wormhole chain with systems, connections and notes in one local workspace.
tip: Bookmark both sides of a connection before moving deeper into the chain.

title: Turn scanning into a clear picture.
description: Keep signatures alongside the systems they belong to, so your next scan has context.
tip: Compare a fresh scan with saved signatures before treating an old connection as current.

title: Home is yours to name.
description: Choose your home system and give it a personal name without changing its EVE system identity.
tip: Use Settings to change your home name. The actual system name remains available for navigation.

title: Keep the chain within reach.
description: The floating Mapping HUD puts mapping tools beside your EVE client.
tip: Open Mapping HUD from the main window and position it where it will not cover your scanner.

title: Know where your pilots are.
description: Link EVE characters to enable location and ship tracking while you explore.
tip: ESI updates can lag behind the client. Confirm your current system in EVE before acting.

title: Plan the route back.
description: Follow mapped connections and use route tools to keep your exit options in view.
tip: Recheck connection life and mass before committing to a return route.

title: Give every connection context.
description: Record wormhole details and use rolling tools to support your decisions.
tip: Mass estimates are planning aids. Other pilots can change a wormhole between observations.

title: Your expedition stays with you.
description: Maps, notes and settings are saved on this PC. Daytripper needs no external database.
tip: Use map export to keep a portable backup before making large changes.
